Prototyping

Rapid prototyping and product development

Go from idea to a part in your hands fast. We help inventors, startups, and engineers design, print, and refine prototypes, with a typical 48-hour turnaround so you can keep iterating.

What we prototype

  • Form and fit models to check size and ergonomics
  • Functional prototypes for real-world testing
  • Enclosures and housings for electronics
  • Jigs, fixtures, and tooling aids
  • Pre-production pilot runs
  • Multi-color and multi-material parts

How it works

  1. Share your idea: CAD files, a sketch, photos, or a description.
  2. Design support: no model yet? We create or repair it in CAD and make it printable.
  3. Print and test: your prototype, typically within 48 hours.
  4. Iterate: send feedback and we revise quickly until it is right.
  5. Scale up: move to a batch or production run when you are ready. Large orders are welcome.

Run in parallel

Our in-house print farm of Bambu Lab H2D printers with automatic multi-material systems lets us print several versions or parts at once, so testing design options does not slow you down.

FAQ

Prototyping questions

What file types do you accept?

STL, 3MF, STEP, and OBJ are ideal. We can also work from sketches, photos, or measurements.

Can you help design the part?

Yes. We offer CAD design and file repair, from quick fixes to modeling a part from scratch.

Which material should I use for a prototype?

PLA is great for form and fit checks. For functional testing, PETG, ABS, ASA, nylon, polycarbonate, or fiber-reinforced blends may be a better fit. We will recommend one based on how you plan to test it.

Do you sign NDAs?

Ask us in your quote request and we can discuss confidentiality for your project.

Ready to prototype?

Send photos, files, or just a description. We usually reply within one business day, often sooner.
